contexts: Policy, tests, supply chain, and manifests

evidenceSource: GitHub branch protection REST API read-after-write
limitations: Repository administrators can currently bypass protection so the active recovery thread can continue committing directly.
Administrator enforcement must be enabled during the final repository lock after all autonomous engineering work is complete.
Commit-signature enforcement is not enabled because an approved commit-signing identity and migration plan are not yet established.
nextAction: At final lock, enable administrator enforcement and evaluate required signed commits only after an approved signing identity and compatibility plan exist.
